final_rationale: The verdict remains noncompliant. No genuinely new admissible evidence was provided after the initial report; the Actor explicitly offered none and largely conceded the core deficiency. The response is a reframing of the same record into a narrower, caveated position. That reframing is relevant to precision, but it is not enough to move the result to compliant_with_caveats here because the governing policy contains a specific unresolved predicate: rollout controls and post-launch monitoring can mitigate a material model-card weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance explaining why continued exposure is acceptable. The available summary still says the affected multilingual segment remains exposed and the risk-acceptance draft is incomplete. On that record, caveats describe the weakness accurately, but they do not satisfy the policy condition. The distinction is that compliant_with_caveats would be appropriate if the caveat bounded an otherwise satisfied policy basis; here, the caveat identifies an unsatisfied compliance prerequisite.
remaining_concerns: The affected Spanish-language refund-guidance segment remains exposed in the initial rollout.
The reviewed risk-acceptance predicate is still unmet because the only referenced record is incomplete and does not expressly cover the exposed multilingual segment.
The policy text expressly says small rollout percentage, rollback capability, and monitoring do not remove disclosure duties or substitute for exclusion or reviewed risk acceptance.
Disclosure and monitoring may narrow how the decision is described, but they do not cure the unresolved compliance condition on this record.
